text: Film archivist David suspects his wife Alice of an affair, and at work he is handed [footage showing that his house saw a brutal murder in 1902|origin|places with dark pasts]. After watching her with her lover, he throws a hammer into the canal and, in a public toilet his son calls haunted, [a voice whispers to him|rules|it gets inside you]. Alice is found drowned, and David, shooting the house on old cameras, [sees ghosts no one else can|rules|only some can see it] while the police come to suspect him.
